items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 26 August 2026 7:33am
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Wednesday, 26 August 2026 at 7:35am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Nil.


##Synopsis##

Slow-moving area of low pressure to the southwest of Britain, with associated weather fronts drifting northwards.


##Wind##

East 4 or 5, decreasing 3 or 4 this afternoon, then occasionally 5 overnight.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate becoming mostly slight this afternoon.


##Weather##

Occasional rain spreading across the area from the south, becoming mainly fair later this evening or early tonight.


##Visibility##

Mostly good, occasionally moderate in rain.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

East or northeast 3 or 4, occasionally 5 in places, backing north or northeast 2 to 4 Thursday afternoon. Further backing northwest 4 occasionally 5 overnight into Friday.


##State of Sea##

Mostly slight.


##Weather##

Mainly fair, then rain developing Thursday afternoon & evening, becoming heavy in places.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate or poor in rain.
